answer_1.quote: We replicate the translation game setting ... The sender agent translates French to English (Fr-En), while a receiver agent translates English to German (En-De).
answer_1.outputs: Generated English intermediate translations and final German translations.

answer_2.quote: We first compute English BLEU score (BLEU En) comparing the generated English translation with the ground truth human translation. We include the negative log-likelihood (NLL) of the generated En translation under a pretrained language model as a measure of syntactic correctness.
